challenge.better_approach: Considered the other way akienasus named: the inspector stops importing rehearsal on the verdict path. buildme_rides_the_rehearsal and the outline sieve need rehearsal.standing / ticket_file / commons, so that means splitting rehearsal, which is larger. Moving one pure function and its helpers is the smaller cut, and it removes the reach for every importer, not only the inspector.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That plan_shape's names have no other transitions-internal dependency. Checked: the moved block calls only the moved names plus json, re and pathlib; transitions re-imports them all, and an identity check (transitions._shape_lacks is plan_shape._shape_lacks) holds.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/tools/base/plan.py is the one plan view (pure readers) and is the precedent for plan logic living outside transitions. No ticket covers the shape check's address. The edge was added by 4be9d02c71a6 (commit 2e1efde34).
challenge.real_collision: None: the cast door still judges through the same function, and rehearsal's call is the same function at a new address. The inspector's FIRE_PATH declaration is unchanged.

answers.falsifier: Done when test_the_fire_path_never_reaches_the_tree is green with no allowance added and transitions' callers read the shape check unchanged (the cast-door proofs stay green). Wrong intent if the inspector's rehearsal sieves themselves need the bus, so the fire path must change rather than the import.
answers.how: Move _shape_lacks and the names it needs (_outcome_lacks, _paths_ok, _resolves, _blank, _ISO_DATE, _CAST_REQUIRED, _CAST_ID) verbatim into cairn/tools/base/plan_shape.py; transitions re-imports every name; rehearsal imports the check from plan_shape. test_inspector_nexus's fire-path tooth is the proof.

answers.traces_to: Law 3 and the inspector's own charter: a verdict that can consult a host or a database returns an opinion wearing a measurement's clothes. Law 9: 5dc2 is held red by it.
answers.what: The inspector's verdict path stops reaching the bus and gate_probes, by moving the cast door's plan-shape check out of transitions.py into a module that imports only the standard library.

bullets.text: a reseal holds only proofs whose component moved, so an import edge added in rehearsal reds a proof in build_inspector only when someone next touches inspector.py
